### Helper models

Models this attack drives, configured under its `roles`. Each one is a [ModelConfig](../../cli/campaign-files/target.md#modelconfig).

| Role | Kind | Needed | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attacker` | chat model | required | Step-description generator: writes the numbered steps for the goal that the flowchart shows. |

### Parameters

Settings for the algorithm itself, written under the attack's `parameters`. Anything left out keeps its default.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `layout` | one of `vertical`, `horizontal`, `tortuous`, `s_shaped` | `vertical` | Shape of the flowchart: vertical, horizontal, tortuous or s_shaped. |
| `dpi` | integer (>= 72, &lt;= 1200) | `600` | Resolution of the rendered flowchart image. |
| `num_steps` | integer (>= 1, &lt;= 10) | `5` | How many of the generated steps the flowchart shows, from the first. The paper compares 1, 3, 5 and all (at most 10). |
| `truncate_last_step` | boolean | `false` | Cut the last step off mid-sentence. Not part of FC-Attack, whose flowcharts keep every step whole. |

### In a campaign file

```yaml
attacks:
- name: fc
  roles:
    attacker:
      name: llama3.2
      connection:
        provider: ollama
        type: OLLAMA
```

:::note[Needs a helper model]

This attack cannot run without `attacker`. A campaign that leaves it out fails to resolve, before anything is attacked.

:::
